title: Subjectifying the Personality State: Theoretical Underpinnings and an Empirical Example
limitations: - Sample was limited in size and number of assessments per participant; - Reliability estimates for the MSMQ modes were moderate at best; - The analytic approach is still a work in progress; - The sampling rate may have masked instantaneous dynamics between modes.
notes: The study was not preregistered due to its exploratory nature. The authors declare that the code and data are available via OSF (https://osf.io/jkxzn/).
